actions: Re-derived the four-corner Gaussian likelihood-ratio envelope analytically.
Converted mean-curvature tail control to an exact Beta-prime residual-tail penalty.
Proved log-scale curvature needs only a fixed compact lower integral because all omitted score-tail contribution is nonnegative.
Ran deterministic sufficient-statistic quadrature only as engineering margin evidence.
Persisted certificate, checkpoint and LATEST and verified checkpoint/LATEST readback.
result_summary: Unbounded-tail certification is no longer the primary blocker for the r87 four-corner RIPr candidate. C_tt reduces to a small compact integral with zero tail penalty; C_mumu reduces to a compact integral plus an exact <=0.0981 Beta-prime negative-tail penalty at R=2000. Engineering compact minima remain about 19.6 and 30.8, leaving substantial slack for interval certification.
blocker: Validated continuum lower enclosures of the two compact integrals are still missing; therefore q/p_rho is not yet promoted to a valid RIPr/numeraire factor.
exact_next_action: Interval-certify the compact C_tt lower integral over the full mean/log-scale rectangle first, then certify compact C_mumu on |ybar|<=1,W<=2000 and subtract the exact <=0.0981 Beta-prime penalty. If both signs close, solve rho with directed rounding and verify active corners before promotion.
